title: DPP-CQ: Digital Product Passport for Cultural & Quality Goods
description: ICO Std 2001-2026 — Core data schema for cultural and quality product digital passports. Based on W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0. v2.0 adds: GS1 Digital Link/GTIN interoperability, dual carrier (QR + SDM NFC), SD-JWT VC format, ISO 14067 carbon footprint optional module, data lifecycle metadata, Chinese national cryptography (SM2/SM3/SM4) suite option, AI-assisted assessment disclosure. All v2.0 additions are OPTIONAL for v1.x credential compatibility.

@context.description: JSON-LD context definitions. Must include W3C VC base context and DPP-CQ context.

id.description: Unique credential identifier. Recommended format: did:ico:dpp:<namespace>:<unique-id>

type.description: Credential type. Must include 'VerifiableCredential' and at least one DPP-CQ type.

issuer.description: DID of the issuing authority. Format: did:ico:issuer:<namespace>

issuanceDate.description: Date and time when the credential was issued (RFC 3339).

validFrom.description: W3C VC v2.0 standard validity start date. MAY be used in place of issuanceDate in SD-JWT VC profiles.

expirationDate.description: Date and time when the credential expires (RFC 3339). RECOMMENDED for quality-sensitive products.

validUntil.description: W3C VC v2.0 standard validity end date. MAY be used in place of expirationDate in SD-JWT VC profiles.

credentialSubject.description: The subject of the credential — the product and its attributes.

productName.description: Product name in multiple languages. Key is ISO 639-1 language code.

category.description: Product category code. See ICO Std 2001 Annex A for full category list.

gs1Identifiers.description: [v2.0] GS1 global identifiers. OPTIONAL. When present, enables resolution via GS1 Digital Link and interoperability with GS1-based systems (EU DPP, retail scanners, customs).

serialNumber.description: GS1 AI (21) serial number for item-level identification.

digitalLink.description: GS1 Digital Link URI resolving to the product passport, e.g. https://id.gtin.info/06901234000017/10/LOT2026A/21/SN0001. See docs/interoperability/gs1-digital-link-mapping.md

glnOwner.description: Global Location Number (13 digits) of the brand owner or responsible entity.

qualityGrade.description: Quality grade per issuing authority's classification scheme.

productImage.description: URI of the product image (IPFS CID or HTTPS URL recommended).

giNumber.description: Official geographical indication registration number, if applicable.

region.description: Region or place of origin name.

culturalData.description: Cultural heritage and intangible cultural value data (optional).

heritageNumber.description: Official ICH registration or inscription number.

craftMethod.description: Description of traditional craftsmanship or production method.

craftHistory.description: Historical background of the craft or product tradition.

artisanInfo.description: Artisan or master craftsman information (with consent).

culturalNarrative.description: Cultural story, legend, or significance narrative.

epcisEvent.description: [v2.0] EPCIS 2.0 event mapping. OPTIONAL. When present, the step is expressible as an EPCIS 2.0 event (ObjectEvent/AggregationEvent/TransformationEvent) per GS1 EPCIS 2.0/CBV 2.0.

epcisEventURI.description: URI of the canonical EPCIS event record.

testStandard.description: [v2.0] Reference standard for the test method, e.g. ISO, GB/T, SPS.

certifications.description: Third-party conformity attestations held by the product or producer. Terminology note: within the DPP-CQ system these are 'attestations/assessments (评定/评价/验证)', not 'certifications (认证)' in the regulatory sense.

assessment.description: [v2.0] DPP-CQ quality assessment disclosure. Records how the quality grade was determined.

methodStandard.description: Assessment methodology standard reference, e.g. ICO Std 3001.

reportReference.description: URI or credential id of the full assessment report.

aiDisclosure.description: [v2.0] REQUIRED when method is 'ai-assisted' or 'hybrid'. AI transparency disclosure aligned with EU AI Act Art. 50 and GB/T 47507-2026 transparency/controllability principles.

tasksPerformed.description: Tasks performed by AI, e.g. ['data extraction', 'sensory score pre-scoring'].

finalDecisionMadeBy.description: Role of the human who made the final decision, e.g. lead assessor.

reviewProcess.description: Description of human review of AI outputs.

modelInfo.description: Model name/version or vendor description (proprietary detail optional).

sustainabilityData.description: [v2.0] Environmental & sustainability module. OPTIONAL. Aligned with ISO 14067 (product carbon footprint) and EU ESPR data attribute directions. Provides the sustainability dimension alongside DPP-CQ's quality dimension.

unit.description: Kilograms or tonnes of CO2 equivalent.

hazardous.description: Whether the material contains substances of concern.

dataLifecycle.description: [v2.0] Data governance and lifecycle metadata. Aligned with GB/T 47507-2026 data security/full-lifecycle requirements and GDPR accountability.

dataController.description: Entity responsible for data processing (legal name).

retentionPolicy.description: Retention period and basis for each data class.

storageLocation.description: Jurisdiction/region where raw data is stored.

crossBorderMode.description: Cross-border data mode. 'hash-only' is the DPP-CQ default: raw data local, hash fingerprints cross-border.

deletionPolicy.description: Data destruction/anonymization rules upon credential revocation or expiry.

privacyNoticeURI.description: URI of the privacy notice presented at verification time.

piaReportURI.description: URI of the Personal Information Impact Assessment / DPIA summary (public portion).

authenticityMarks.description: Physical anti-counterfeiting features registered on-chain. v2.0 carrier levels: L1 open QR (any reader), L2 secure NFC with SDM (NTAG 424 DNA class), L3 tamper-evident NFC (TagTamper class). See docs/interoperability/carrier-specification.md.

chipModel.description: e.g. 'NXP NTAG 424 DNA', 'NXP NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper'.

qrGrade.description: QR print quality grade per ISO/IEC 15415, e.g. 'B' or better.

openlyReadable.description: Whether the carrier resolves with any standard reader without proprietary app (EN 18220 'open data carrier' requirement).

proof.description: Digital proof of the credential. v2.0 supports two profiles: (a) W3C Data Integrity proofs (JSON-LD VC; BBS+ for unlinkable selective disclosure); (b) IETF SD-JWT VC (RFC 9529 + SD-JWT VC draft) for compact, selective-disclosure JWT credentials. Profile selection per docs/specs/credential-formats.md.

type.description: Proof suite type. Data Integrity profiles: BbsBlsSignature2020 (unlinkable ZK-style selective disclosure), DataIntegrityProof (Ed25519). SD-JWT VC profile uses 'SdJwtCredential2025' wrapper with the cryptographic suite in cryptoSuite.

cryptoSuite.description: [v2.0] Cryptographic suite identifier. International suites: 'ecdsa-sd-2023' (SD-JWT VC ECDSA), 'eddsa-2022'. Chinese national cryptography suites (for domestic deployments): 'sm2-with-sm3-2026' (SM2 signature per GB/T 32918, SM3 digest per GB/T 32905). SM4 (GB/T 32907) applies to payload encryption, not signatures.

conformityClaims.description: [v2.0] Self-declared conformity claims to external frameworks. Modeled on UN/CEFACT UNTP conformity claim vocabulary. Each claim references the framework, the assessed scope, and the attestation evidence. This is the bridge for regulators/importers to map DPP-CQ credentials to ESPR, EN standards, and national regulations.

claim.description: Conformity statement, e.g. 'DPP data carrier meets open-carrier and unique-identifier requirements'.

assessmentReference.description: URI of the conformity assessment / self-assessment document.

attestedBy.description: DID of the attesting body (self or third party).
